Jval Patel, born in 2011, recently became an IM at the age of 14 years. He is the top seed of the National under-15 championships 2026 in India. He took on Johan Jobsy 1842 in the 2nd round of the event. The rating difference was almost 580 Elo points. Check out the game to see what transpired. Commentary by IM Sagar Shah.
Video: ChessBase India
